item.title: Zluda 6 bridges the CUDA gap, but hardware emulation remains a moving target
item.description: The latest release allows unmodified CUDA applications to run on non-Nvidia hardware, offering a rare escape hatch from proprietary vendor lock-in. However, maintaining parity with Nvidia's rapidly evolving ecosystem creates a permanent engineering tax and potential performance overhead for production workloads.

item.title: Anthropic patches memory amplification vulnerability in Protocol Buffers decoder
item.description: A newly disclosed denial-of-service flaw (CVE-2026-55407) in Anthropic's custom Protobuf decoder allowed attackers to trigger a 22x memory amplification spike. While fixing it prevents infrastructure crashes, the incident highlights how modern fast-paced AI deployments frequently compromise on boring, fundamental data-parsing discipline.
